Realized Cap: Realized Cap values different part of the supplies at different prices (instead of using the current daily close). Specifically, it is computed by valuing each UTXO by the price when it was last moved.

Realized Price: Realized Price is the Realized Cap divided by the current suppl

Net Realized Profit/Loss: Net Realized Profit/Loss is the net profit or loss of all moved coins, and is defined by the difference of Realized Profit - Realized Loss.

Realized Profit/Loss Ratio:  Realized Profit/Loss Ratio is the ratio between all coins moved at a profit and at a loss, i.e. Realized Profit / Realized Loss.

Realized Cap: Realized Cap values different part of the supplies at different prices (instead of using the current daily close). Specifically, it is computed by valuing each UTXO by the price when it was last moved.

Realized Price: Realized Price is the Realized Cap divided by the current suppl

Net Realized Profit/Loss: Net Realized Profit/Loss is the net profit or loss of all moved coins, and is defined by the difference of Realized Profit - Realized Loss.

Realized Profit/Loss Ratio:  Realized Profit/Loss Ratio is the ratio between all coins moved at a profit and at a loss, i.e. Realized Profit / Realized Loss.
